s.note: Harper and Charlie sharing pizza in the empty office
s.how: Stretch pizza dough thin on a tray. Spread with pizza sauce, scatter with grated mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano. Bake at 250C for 10 minutes until bubbling. Cut and put back in a box, then eat on the office floor at midnight.

s.note: the baseball game where they stage the kiss cam
s.how: Fry 2 sliced onions slowly until soft and golden. Grill 8 hot dog franks until they split. Tuck into soft buns with the onions and yellow mustard and wrap in paper. Hand them to the bosses as the kiss cam swings around.

m.note: the fancy dinner the assistants set up for their bosses
m.how: Roast 1kg potato chunks at 220C for 45 minutes. Sear 4 sirloin steaks and rest. Toast cracked peppercorns in the pan, add 200ml cream and simmer until thick. Steam asparagus and toss with butter. Serve on white plates.

w.note: the office parties the assistants have to organise
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Pipe vanilla buttercream on top and finish with sprinkles. Leave a tray in the break room.

d.n: Iced salted caramel latte for the boss
d.note: Harper and Charlie fetching coffee for their bosses
d.how: Make the caramel: melt 100g caster sugar in a saucepan until amber, take off the heat and whisk in 60ml cream and 20g butter, then half a tsp sea salt. Cool. Pull 4 double shots of espresso. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, add 2 tbsp caramel and 200ml cold milk to each, then pour the espresso over. Top with whipped cream (100ml whipped) and a pinch of salt.
